checkpoint_review: The Router was generally rigorous but slightly lenient on the 'Three prominent horns' checkpoint. While it marked it false due to the right subject's missing horn, it should have explicitly flagged this as a structural generation failure (asymmetry/missing part) rather than just an occlusion issue, given the clear view of the head. The Router correctly identified that body/limb checkpoints are untestable. The verdict on 'Skin texture' being false is accurate; the AI generated a smooth, plastic-like surface instead of scales.
artifact_review: The Router underestimated the severity of the 'texture_anomaly' (Severity 2). The complete lack of biological texture (scales/pores) on a close-up subject is a significant fidelity failure, warranting at least Severity 3. The 'structural_collapse' at the eye/horn junction (Severity 3) is accurately rated; the geometry is indeed muddy. The Router missed a subtle artifact: the lighting inconsistency between the two subjects. The left skeletal head has harsh, direct lighting, while the right fleshy head has soft, diffuse lighting, suggesting they may not belong in the same physical space (compositing artifact).
alignment_reasoning: Only 1 out of 5 testable checkpoints passed (Beak). The primary diagnostic feature (3 horns) failed on the main subject. Skin texture and frill morphology deviated significantly from taxonomy (plastic vs. scaled/smooth bone). The fine_grained_classifier confirmed the class identity (Triceratops), but this only confirms semantic intent, not anatomical correctness. The image fails to represent the biological reality of the class.
artifact_reasoning: Router identified texture anomalies and structural melting. I am upgrading the texture anomaly severity due to the total absence of expected micro-details (scales). The topology mask shows high confidence, meaning the object is coherent, but the internal structure (eye/horn fusion) is flawed. The lighting mismatch between the two heads suggests a compositing or generation consistency error.
key_defects: Missing second brow horn on right subject (Structural Asymmetry)
Plastic/rubber skin texture lacking hexagonal scales (Texture Fidelity)
Melted geometry at eye/horn junction (Structural Integrity)
Inconsistent lighting between left and right subjects (Spatial Coherence)
